description: Type text one character at a time, firing the key events a real keyboard would. Use this instead of session_fill when a field only reacts to keystrokes — search boxes with live suggestions, autocompletes, and inputs with per-character validation. Returns {typed} with the number of characters sent. Slower than session_fill, so reach for it only when session_fill leaves the page unchanged.

ref.description: A ref from session_snapshot, such as @e12, used instead of selector

selector.description: CSS selector for the field to type into

tabId.description: Tab to act on; uses the active tab when omitted

text.description: Text to type, one character at a time

name: session_type
